I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The incident channel's history says this. Tobias is a member of that channel, so they can see it too. On 3 Sep 2025, Pree reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. She posted at 18:43 that it was fixed and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I told Tobias that nobody posted a street address for the site, and that the shared files they can see don't have one either.
